title: Execution models belong in foundational computing curricula
proposition: A beginner systems foundation should introduce instruction execution, state, memory, and cross-layer representations before later systems specialization.
scope: Curriculum positioning for V01-C02; not a prescribed hardware-architecture course.
exceptions: The depth and machine model must remain appropriate to Programming Foundations.
score_rationale: Two independent Tier 1 curriculum/course sources directly support a simplified cross-layer model; non-academic tiers are not required for curriculum placement.
